Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h2", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description - try multiple elements description = "" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: description = next_p.get_text(strip=True) else: next_div = block.find_next_sibling("div") if next_div: description = next_div.get_text(strip=True)[:300] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text, {}), "return_type": "unknown", }) # 3.
